string.text: A former FICT student who has kept the strength of Polyana and the prudence of Dorm 8.
A former KPI Telecom engineer who swapped his server room for a shack at the Forestry. Plans to start a business on anonymous data storage.
A router from the FICT lab that Rokovoy brought back from China. Whatever is in its firmware, plenty of people in the Zone would like to get their hands on it.
Polytech asked you to find Faraday, who is holding on to Rokovoy's router. He is hiding in a shack at the Forestry.
Faraday has the router. Talk to him and get it.
Faraday is dead. The router should still be on his body.
Bandits have come for the router. Help Faraday fight them off.
You have the router. Bring it to Polytech at the Skadovsk.
